title: Itadaki Street 2 - Neon Sign wa Barairo ni
aliases: Itadaki Street 2: Neon Sign wa Barairo ni
Itadaki Street 2: Neon Sign wa Bara Iro ni
description: Following up on the original Itadaki Street, Itadaki Street 2 features more complex Monopoly-esque gameplay and new gambling elements. Released for the Super Famicom on Feb. 26, 1994 in Japan, and again on Sep. 26, 1997.
